name: file_touch
title: Change file access and modification times

origin.description:
Like the touch POSIX utility this will create the file if it does not
exist.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character vector of one or more paths.

arguments.name: access_time, modification_time
arguments.text:
The times to set, inputs will be
coerced to POSIXct objects.
